name: FSFFL Projection Championship & Ensemble
purpose: Select and blend preseason projection evidence by position and raw football statistic using leakage-safe historical holdouts, while preserving FSFFL Native as an independent model and keeping source rights/deployment context explicit.

v1_ensemble.weight_learning: For each position/stat/holdout season, use only earlier common-cohort seasons.
v1_ensemble.inverse_mae_shrinkage: Blend inverse-MAE weights 50% toward equal weights by default; configurable in benchmark.
v1_ensemble.promotion_rule: A category method must improve leakage-safe holdout MAE versus both the incumbent production source and equal-weight blend without material coverage loss. Sparse categories remain provisional.
v1_ensemble.fallback: If evidence gates are not met, retain the governed incumbent source for that category.

allowed_use: evaluate whether Native adds independent residual signal to an ensemble
native_learning_policy.residual_learning_gate: Any Native residual correction must be fit only on prior seasons and prove value on later temporal holdouts.

PERSONAL_RESEARCH.source_gate: Source terms must permit the contemplated personal use; provenance and replacement status remain recorded.

COMMERCIAL.description: Any paid, public, organizational, redistributed, or revenue-generating deployment.
COMMERCIAL.source_gate: Only sources with explicitly verified commercial/model/redistribution rights may be dependencies; otherwise replace, license, or exclude them.
